messages.text: Literal `pnpm typecheck` exits 1 in this session because pnpm's verify-deps-before-run saw package.json change (phase-7-backend-release is editing it) and ran `pnpm install`; its postinstall `prisma migrate deploy` then failed with 'database is locked' on data/fitpulse.db. The script it runs is `tsc --noEmit`, which exits 0 with the same tree. Once phase-7-backend-release finishes and no process holds data/fitpulse.db, run `pnpm install` once, then `pnpm typecheck` and confirm exit 0.

Capability-level checks not run by this unit (owned by integration, after the sibling e2e specs exist): pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/home.spec.ts tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts, covering AC-ra-34 (interval options 60/90/120/180 with reload), AC-ra-35 (?atencao= drill-down filters), AC-ra-62 (mode switch), plus the Play dev-link walkthrough.

findings.summary: The literal Done-when command `pnpm typecheck` was run twice in the foreground (logs typecheck-1.log and typecheck-2.log, exit codes 1 and 1). Both failed inside pnpm's automatic dependency install (postinstall prisma migrate deploy: 'database is locked' on data/fitpulse.db) before tsc ran. This is environmental: phase-7-backend-release is editing package.json and about 20 other node processes are running. It is not a type error. The same script run as `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false typecheck` exited 0 with no TS errors (typecheck-3-noverify.log, exit code 0). The literal command still needs one clean run at integration.

Behavioural check not run: the settings interval (60/90/120/180 days) must persist after reload. Only the option list was confirmed by reading ReevaluationSection.tsx line 12. The e2e spec was not run because it belongs to integration (`pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts`).

Behavioural check not run: consultant home attention links must drill down to /empresas?atencao=<atrasada|vencidas|risco|rascunhos|sem-diagnostico|aguardando> and CompaniesPage must apply the filter. Verified only by grep anchors (ConsultantHome.tsx buildAttentionHref, CompaniesPage.tsx parseAttention and listCompanies call). Integration should run tests/e2e/home.spec.ts and tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts.

Behavioural check not run: consultant/owner mode switch (AC-ra-62). Not exercised here. Integration should run tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts and tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts and do the Play dev-link walkthrough.

evidence.summary: Failed in pnpm auto-install postinstall (prisma migrate deploy: database is locked). No tsc output reached.
Same DB-lock failure in the postinstall step. Not attributable to the unit.
Runs the project's `typecheck` script (`tsc --noEmit`) without the automatic install. Exit 0. The log has no 'error TS' lines, so no type errors in the unit files or the sibling files.
Line 12: INTERVAL_OPTIONS = [60, 90, 120, 180]; line 13: RECOMMENDED_INTERVAL = 90. Line 53: data-aioson-id=settings-reevaluation-interval. Matches the spec options.

buildAttentionHref (line ~43) builds /empresas?atencao=<attention>. The 'aguardando' value is typed locally (HomeAttention). Line 34-35 reads awaitingQuestionnaires ?? [] (IF-011 optional key). Line 170 reads data.overdueActions and line 181 reads data.reevaluationDays. The anchors consult-attention (line 212) and data-attention (line 221) are present.

URL owns filters: ?atencao= parsed by parseAttention (line 57) and sent to listCompanies (line 90). 'aguardando' is a local ListAttention type (line 14) cast to CompanyAttention at the call. 'Limpar filtros' (lines 233, 269) and 'Nenhuma empresa encontrada' (line 265) are present.

Line 14 types 'aguardando' as a local ListAttention and line 90 casts attention to CompanyAttention. This is a cast, not a type guard. Under tsc the cast compiles, and the server returns the set (IF-011). Noted for the owner; not a defect.
